name: spatial/particle-field
title: Cursor-reactive particle field
description: Particles that drift and part around the cursor.

files.content:
export { flowAngle, ParticleField } from './ParticleField';
export type { ParticleFieldProps } from './ParticleField';

notes: Decorative: hidden from assistive technology; nothing in it can be operated.
Never required: a still dot pattern is shown where 3D rendering is unavailable.
Pauses when off screen or when the tab is hidden, and holds still under reduced motion.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Draws one still frame of the particles.
